front: Which EM waves are used for satellite communication?

back: One that orbits above the equator once every 24 hours, so it stays above the same point on the Earth.

front: Why microwaves for mobile phones and Wi-Fi?
back: They penetrate some walls and need only short aerials.
They pass through walls but are weakened, so the range is short.

front: Why light or infrared in optical fibres?
back: Glass is transparent to them, and they carry very high data rates.
Analogue: varies continuously. Digital: only a few values, usually 1 and 0.
Faster data transmission and longer range, because regenerators remove noise and rebuild the signal exactly.
